scope: Narrow resource reuse, accounting and fixed seed schedule review only; no genotype creation, preparation invocation, imports of engine, builds or lives.

cost_projection.limitation: Observed developed-body costs and fixed margins do not bound new mutants/endpoints.

cost_limits: Projection uses the maximum of all three Z background rates, including original/Y/Z; it is conservative relative to measured developed bodies only.
Novel offspring/endpoints may cost more; 9000 aggregate CPU cap and 7200 search cap remain authoritative.
Four search processes each perform their existing two startup goldens; confirmation has one additional pair. No calibration process or extra hidden golden is planned.
comparison_limits: Matching selection lives does not match generations, mutation exposures, periodic validation or total calls. These differences are predeclared.
Paired native seeds intentionally share generation0, validation0 and final life IDs, including different purposes of gen indices3..6 under two scoring policies.
Only two founder/policy pairs; paired life uncertainty does not estimate general superiority across evolutionary replicates.
